segments.vv74:1.1: “Yā devarājassa sabhā sudhammā, yatthacchati devasaṅgho samaggo;
segments.vv74:1.3: Tathūpamaṃ tuyhamidaṃ vimānaṃ, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe.
segments.vv74:2.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv74:3.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv74:4.1: “Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto, rañño pāyāsissa ahosiṃ māṇavo;
segments.vv74:4.3: Laddhā dhanaṃ saṃvibhāgaṃ akāsiṃ, piyā ca me sīlavanto ahesuṃ;
segments.vv74:4.5: Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
segments.vv74:9.1: Dve agārino phaladāyī, dve upassayadāyī bhikkhāya dāyī;
segments.vv74:9.3: Yavapālako ceva dve, kuṇḍalino pāyāsīti [pāṭhabhedo natthi];

lines: Pāyāsissa ahosiṃ māṇavoti pāyāsirājaññassa kiccākiccakaro daharatāya māṇavo, nāmena pana uttaro nāma ahosiṃ.
Saṃvibhāgaṃ akāsinti ahameva abhuñjitvā yathāladdhaṃ dhanaṃ dānamukhe pariccajanavasena saṃvibhajanaṃ akāsiṃ.
